assessment: This study presents four high quality cryo-EM structures of ADP-actin filaments formed from skeletal α-, cardiac α-, cytoplasmic β- and cytoplasmic γ-actin. These structures are important for understanding the functional differences among these actin isoforms. This work is of significant general interest, because actin filaments, composed of different actin isoforms, have a critical role in a number of physiological processes from muscle contraction to cell migration and division.
